assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was ordered
The monitoring was intended to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The extended monitoring period constitutes the medical necessity justification for the service
The CPT code for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is 93229
